prayerExcerpt.en-US: The blessed apostles, then, having founded and built up the Church, committed into the hands of Linus the office of the episcopate.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Os bem-aventurados apóstolos, tendo então fundado e edificado a Igreja, confiaram às mãos de Lino o ofício do episcopado.

meta.face: A man of about fifty with a broad, hexagonal face — a low, wide forehead and wide, flat cheekbones angling to a broad jaw; a straight, wide nose with a blunt tip; wide-set, round dark eyes under thick, gently arched brows; a rounded chin under the beard; a straight, full mouth; dark hair greying at the temples and receding at the brow, a full, rounded salt-and-pepper beard of medium length, and a steady, gentle gaze. Beard neither white nor tapering.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual gives Linus, of the Seventy, 'a rounded beard'; the Menologion of Basil II shows him older and balding with a rounded beard. The face takes the rounded beard of both and a middle age between them.
meta.excerpt: St. Irenaeus, Against Heresies III.3.3 (ANF translation, public domain, verbatim), pt-BR rendered from it
